shadow_strike.name: Shadow Strike
shadow_strike.description: Melee strikes made while invisible deal 50% more damage.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.description: The bonus melee hit from GRACE deals 50% more damage.

long_shot.name: Long Shot
long_shot.description: Increases bow range by 1 tile without extending vision.

fleetfoot.name: Fleetfoot
fleetfoot.description: Ignores equipment SPD penalties and makes you immune to Slow.

immovable.name: Immovable
immovable.description: Prevents involuntary displacement by knockback, pulls and wrestlers.

gods_chosen.name: God's Chosen
gods_chosen.description: Enemy critical hits against you become ordinary hits.

brace.name: Brace
brace.description: While stationary since the previous action, gain 20% DEF (at least +2).

vigorplate.name: Vigorplate
vigorplate.description: At 75% HP or higher, gain 30% DEF (at least +3).

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.description: Gain +1 DEF per adjacent enemy, up to +3.

dreadful_strike.name: Dreadful Strike
dreadful_strike.description: Damaging melee hits have a 20% chance to cause fear for 5 player turns.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.description: Below 30% maximum HP, your melee attacks gain 25% ATK.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: Damaging critical melee hits push surviving enemies one legal tile away.

lifesteal.name: Lifesteal
lifesteal.description: Damaging melee hits have a 30% chance to heal one third of actual damage dealt.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: Damaging melee hits have a 30% chance to slow enemies for 3 player turns.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Damaging melee hits have a 20% chance to apply the normal venom effect.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.description: Each damaging melee hit permanently lowers the target DEF by 1, up to 10 (minimum DEF 0).

blindness.name: Blindness
blindness.description: Damaging melee hits have a 10% chance to permanently lower enemy ATK or, once, AGGRO.

martial_bravery.name: Bravery
martial_bravery.description: Melee damage +25% against a stronger enemy or when at least 3 enemies surround you.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.description: After holding position since the preceding action, arrows gain +15 percentage points to hit and +50% damage.

crippling_shot.name: Crippling Shot
crippling_shot.description: Damaging bow shots have a 30% chance to slow enemies for 3 player turns.

bulwark_bravery.name: Bravery
bulwark_bravery.description: Damage from a stronger enemy empowers your next successful melee hit by 25%.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: Blocking or receiving a glancing melee hit empowers your next damaging melee strike by 50%. Misses keep the charge.

retribution.name: Retribution
retribution.description: Store all HP lost. Your next damaging melee hit adds 50% of that stored damage; misses do not consume it.

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.description: Every landed melee strike costs 1% of maximum HP, rounded up, and adds the same amount to damage. This can kill you.

shield_mastery.name: Shield Mastery
shield_mastery.description: Increases your existing shielding block chance by 10 percentage points.

counterguard.name: Counterguard
counterguard.description: Increases block chance by 15 percentage points against armed enemies.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: After blocking an adjacent enemy, 50% chance to bash for 30% of your DEF (subject to target DEF), then push one legal tile.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: When HP drops from above 25% to 25% or less without killing you, reduce subsequent damage by 50% for 3 turns; 50-turn cooldown.

sacred_aegis.name: Sacred Aegis
sacred_aegis.description: Absorbs one damaging melee, projectile or direct spell hit. Recharge: 10 player turns.

rhythm_guard.name: Rhythm Guard
rhythm_guard.description: Two damaging direct strikes in one action prepare a guard that halves the next incoming hit.

bulwark_evasion.name: Evasion
bulwark_evasion.description: Each attack you make prepares a 30% chance to dodge the next landed melee or projectile hit; preparing again never stacks.

boneplate.name: Boneplate
boneplate.description: Each enemy death within 2 tiles grants +1 DEF for 5 turns, up to 5 independent stacks.

plague_mail.name: Plague Mail
plague_mail.description: Gain +1 DEF for every poisoned enemy within 2 tiles. Enemy attacks normally able to poison you always do, unless you are immune.

blood_reservoir.name: Blood Reservoir
blood_reservoir.description: Store 25% of HP lost, up to 25% of maximum HP. Add the stored damage to your next damaging melee hit.

pain_eater.name: Pain Eater
pain_eater.description: Each separate HP-loss event adds 1 damage to your next melee attack. A miss spends the charge.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: A melee strike that brings a living enemy from above 20% HP to 20% HP or below immediately grants one extra strike against it, once per enemy.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Each landed melee strike also strikes enemies adjacent to both you and the target, at 60% power before their defenses. Extra targets do not trigger on-hit effects.

soulburst.name: Soulburst
soulburst.description: A direct melee killing blow releases a blast across a 7×7 area around the victim. It deals 30% of the finishing blow, subject to each enemy’s DEF, and cannot pass walls or chain.

martial_evasion.name: Evasion
martial_evasion.description: Damaging a surviving enemy grants a 30% chance to step onto a random legal adjacent tile after the attack sequence. At most one step per attack action.

binding.name: Binding
binding.description: Every landed melee strike binds the surviving enemy, preventing its Flee and Thief abilities until you actually move.

elusive.name: Elusive
elusive.description: When an enemy misses you in melee, you may take one free step with your next movement action. An attack or another action forfeits it.

death_veil.name: Death Veil
death_veil.description: Killing an enemy with a direct melee strike while invisible adds 5 turns to your existing invisibility without breaking it.

petrifying_strike.name: Petrifying Strike
petrifying_strike.description: Damaging melee hits have a 15% chance to make a foe lose its next action.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: Damaging melee hits have a 30% chance to prevent enemy spellcasting for 3 player turns.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.description: Damaging melee hits have a 20% chance to confuse a foe for 3 turns; it may move randomly or attack another creature.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.description: Damaging melee hits have a 10% chance to knock a weapon or shield from an equipped enemy. The dropped item can be picked up.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Enemies detect you from 3 tiles farther away and do not retreat solely because of your strength or bow.

fear_aura.name: Fear Aura
fear_aura.description: A frightened foe fleeing can spread fear to nearby enemies (20% per target, once per turn).

fear_eater.name: Fear Eater
fear_eater.description: Gain +1 ATK per visible frightened enemy within 10 tiles, up to +5.

executioners_aura.name: Executioner's Aura
executioners_aura.description: Killing an unharmed enemy with one direct melee strike can frighten nearby foes for 3 turns (50% chance).

soul_eater.name: Soul Eater
soul_eater.description: Killing a non-ghost humanoid has a 50% chance to summon its hostile ghost. Killing it grants +1 ATK for 300 turns; each bonus expires separately.
